title: Havana Cathedral
visualBrief: Individual Havana Cathedral:unequal narrow clock tower and broad two-stage open belfry frame a wavy carved pale-stone Baroque screen with three recessed timber doors,two column orders,blind niches,broken/curved cornices,simplified volutes and floral/oval glazing. Red clay pitched nave/aisle/rear roofs and mapped broad rear dome with arched sails and small open lantern/cap complete the envelope. Four raw map controls,four browser levels and four shared256-square material graphs. Fine figures/interlace/lettering,hidden annex partitions,full interiors/engineering and exact ground joins simplified or unverified.

nativeAxes.z: west-southwest toward narrow clock tower;wide belfry on negative side
